texts.value: Alpha subunit of soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC), a central enzyme in nitric oxide (NO) signaling. Functions as the main intracellular receptor for NO. Upon NO binding, catalyzes the conversion of GTP to cyclic GMP (cGMP) and thereby transducing NO signal into a ubiquitous intracellular second messenger
Acts as a negative regulator of guanylyl cyclase activity as it forms non-functional heterodimers with the beta subunit
